name: @pynwheel/igloohome-ble
description: Capacitor plugin around the igloohome Bluetooth SDK (Android co.igloo.home:sdk 3.x from igloohome's GitLab registry, iOS IgloohomeSDK.xcframework): scan for a lock, connect with a guest key, unlock. The native half of the Pynwheel Tour app's igloohome v1 flow.
